title: The Codex /login dialog shows a stale cached browser challenge across tabs
outcome: Every open TermAl tab shows the current /login browser challenge, or none, after another tab starts, finishes or cancels a login.
acceptance: When a second tab's account state changes (a new login started, or the login ends), the first tab's CodexAccountDialog no longer shows the old challenge link or code, shown by a UI test.
The current tab's own challenge display is unchanged.
